author_instruction: 继续加数据，重复之前的步骤，尝试做到 R2 > 0.6；估计数据得千位级；利用 agent 集群来提高效率。

objective.primary: raise the epsilon main scoreboard grouped hybrid R2 above 0.60 on the FROZEN scoring pool, by widening only the TRAINING pool
objective.expected_scale: thousand-level rows and (if the sources allow) hundreds to thousands of training compounds

frozen_quantities_never_moved.splitter: GroupKFold by InChIKey, 10 repeats x 5 folds, seed 42
frozen_quantities_never_moved.model: XGBRegressor with the frozen v1.0 hyper-parameters, n_jobs=1
frozen_quantities_never_moved.frozen_red_lines: the six digests in export_week17_results.FROZEN_RED_LINES must stay INTACT

training_pool_rule.expansion: new near-room observations from the expansion tracks, added to train_mask only
training_pool_rule.never: no expansion row may enter score_mask; no scoring-pool row may be dropped
training_pool_rule.phase: liquid, pure component (no mixtures, no solutions, no electrolytes)

admission_gates_for_a_new_observation: frequency_mhz <= 1.0, or explicitly labelled static / zero-frequency
structure resolved to a canonical InChIKey (no name-only rows may be fitted)
provenance recorded: source url/file + sha256 + retrieval timestamp
license recorded, and the source must be redistributable-or-local (a non-redistributable source may only be used after an explicit governance entry)

primary_criterion.rule: the rebuilt scoreboard's grouped Morgan+Physical R2 exceeds 0.60
primary_criterion.comparison: against the same folds and the same scored rows, with the baseline arm re-run in the same script and required to reproduce 0.4091179943351143 within 1e-9

governance_criteria_three_arms.arm_a_label_placebo: the new block's epsilon labels permuted across its compounds, rows/composition/regularisation untouched; delta_r2 must stay <= +0.02
governance_criteria_three_arms.arm_b_dose_response: 25 / 50 / 75 / 100 percent sub-sampling of the expansion block; the delta curve must be monotone non-decreasing within float tolerance
decision_text: primary met AND arm A passes AND arm B is monotone -> the gain may be written up as observation-level information
primary met but arm A or arm B fails -> the number is still reported, but only as a data-volume effect and never as an information claim
primary missed -> reported as missed, with the achieved number and the shortfall

linearm_upgrade_targets.note: the promoted headline (0.4766400383507876) already carries lever 4 + lever 8; the expansion experiment reuses that feature configuration so the two effects are read separately

shots.policy: every scored attempt at the main scoreboard is counted, including failed ones

honest_boundaries: the scoring pool is 457 rows but only 276 distinct (compound, temperature) pairs; the honest sample size is 276
the expansion set is NOT a random sample of chemical space: it is whatever the sources actually tabulate, so coverage bias must be measured and reported
a large expansion block whose target distribution differs from the scoring pool can move R2 through distribution shift alone; arm A and arm B exist to separate that from information
no expansion row is ever delivered as a scored observation, and no outward bundle may quote the expansion's R2 without the pool definition
expansion_tracks: nbs514 -- the local NBS Circular 514 PDF and its already-parsed organic parts
pubchem_pugview -- PubChem experimental dielectric constant over a broad CID set
open_data -- Zenodo / figshare / GitHub / open-access supplement tables of solvent dielectric constants
local_sweep -- everything already on disk (g1plus webbook/tier3, reference PDFs, coverage_gap targets)
